visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene begins in a brightly lit modern office. A man in a light blue suit stands near a shelf filled with awards and a YouTube play button, looking over his shoulder with a suspicious expression. (2) Close-up on a blonde woman with pigtails wearing a white shirt; her eyes are wide and she looks startled as a man in a black blazer leans in to whisper to her. (3) The blonde woman laughs hysterically with her mouth wide open while the man in the blue suit continues to watch from a distance. (4) The camera pulls back to a wide shot showing the office layout. Two men, one in blue and one in black, walk towards each other from opposite sides of the room with exaggerated, stiff movements. They stop at their desks and perform a synchronized deep bow before sitting down abruptly. (5) A woman with pink hair appears, leaning over to whisper into the ears of both men in turn. After each whisper, she stands up and shouts with an exaggerated facial expression. (6) The man in the black blazer stands up suddenly and shouts toward the camera. He and the man in blue then exit the frame quickly. (7) The blonde woman is left alone in the office holding a yellow hair styling tool, looking around with a confused and frustrated expression.
